scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/city install && npm --prefix apps/chat-debate install && python -m pip install -r apps/chat-debate/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n city,chat -c cyan,green "npm --prefix apps/city run dev" "npm --prefix apps/chat-debate run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/city run build && npm --prefix apps/chat-debate run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/city run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/chat-debate run typecheck
